notes: All seven floor IDs decoded in both overhead images.
Yaw is the circular mean of two independent planar rectifications; their per-tag disagreement was 0.46 degrees or less.
The rectified black-square sizes were 26.78 to 27.13 mm, consistent with the generated 27.2 mm design.
The operator confirmed that adjacent floor-grid sites were placed one foot (304.8 mm) apart. The 5 mm center uncertainty remains to cover tape-placement and recollection error.

2026-09-19: tags 106/110/111/115/116/118 added as anchors at grid sites (-2,2), (-1,0), (-1,1), (-2,0), (-3,2), (-2,1); operator confirmed they are taped at grid points. Camera survey against the seven photographed anchors: with a pinhole model the tags appeared 2-10 cm off toward +x, growing with distance (the 2026-09-12 '20 px' mismatch); with one radial-distortion term per camera (k1 about -0.33 for the ELP modules) the total reprojection rms fell from 7.5 to 1.4 px and the offsets to 1-24 mm. Lesson: these lenses need k1 when anchors span the frame; a pinhole fit of 13 anchors is worse than one of 7 close together.
